title: The query log's gap step files a new public gap for a question a closed entry of the same question settled as a _self question
goal: querylog.py's gap step keeps no new finding, and writes no new _gaps.md entry, for a question whose lower-cased text matches a _gaps.md entry already closed (a Closed or Resolved note), or that the _self root's pack answers good with a tested question; found 2026-11-09 when 'which coordination strategy does a session suggest when another item touching the same files is working' (asked 4 times) was filed again as F-ed67905154ee hours after F-debac1b47a9e closed it as a _self question
repro_reason: needs a planted store with a closed entry and a new lookup of the same question; the planner writes the real repro
